newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia trade surplus up 68.1 pct in Jan-April.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia trade surplus up 68.1 pct in Jan-April.

text.p: Mongolia's trade surplus in the first four months increased by 68.1 percent to $11.6 million from $6.9 million in the year-ago period, the State Statistical Bulletin said on Friday.
Exports in January-April fell 13.9 percent to $115.3 million, from $133.9 million a year ago, it said.
Imports declined 18.3 percent to $103.7 million, from $127 million a year ago, it said.
Nearly half of all exports, valued at $51.07 million went to Switzerland, while exports to China were worth $21.74 million and those to Russia were valued at $11.61 million.
Mongolia's biggest source of imports was Russia, accounting for $36 million, followed by $15.3 million from Italy and $10.49 million from Denmark, the bulletin said.
